Iron accumulation disorder; organ distribution varies across subtypes, and deposition alone does not establish organ dysfunction.

Disease of the pituitary endocrine gland; the brain-disorder ancestor does not establish additional neurologic damage.

Inherited platelet adhesion disorder with enlarged dysfunctional platelets and bleeding.
Direct toxic injury to airways and alveoli; chemical inflammation does not establish an infectious or immune-mediated mechanism.
Chromosomal neurodevelopmental syndrome defined by developmental impairment, severe speech deficits and hypotonia; no additional common organ damage established.

Benign smooth muscle tumor arising in the CNS; histologic muscle lineage does not establish locomotor muscle involvement.
